Sorcery::desc.src: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Enlightenment::desc.src: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana and instead refund 25% of their original cost.

Transcendence::desc.src: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

Phantom Slip::desc.src: Activating Life Steal or Mana Steal will grant +60% speed bonus for 0.7 seconds.

Stagnant Air::desc.src: Air Shout gains doubled area and damage, but is delayed with decreased velocity and hit rate.

Blinding Lights::desc.src: All Ophanim orbs deal 250% damage, gain +5 Crystallize per hit, and instead orbit around you. Using Main Attack causes all orbs to travel faster.

Altruism::desc.src: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.
Altruism::desc.dst: 16 格內的友軍會獲得等同於你從生命恢復與生命竊取中獲得的 100% 生命值

Brutal Blow::desc.src: Armour Breaker now gives an extra +10% damage and has its cooldown reduced by 5s, but lasts half as long.

Gunk Shot::desc.src: Arrow Bomb's velocity is doubled but loses -66% radius and -20% damage.

Hawkeye::desc.src: Arrow Hurricane becomes a condensed stream of 25 arrows, dealing 45%, 6%, and 6% each.

Evershot::desc.src: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

Ice Storm::desc.src: Arrow Shield and Snowstorm's radius' increase by 6 blocks. Arrow Shield's charges are doubled, but no longer give defense.

Heartbeat::desc.src: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Rock Shield::desc.src: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Fan the Hammer::desc.src: Arrow Storm becomes a single stream of 6 high-powered arrows that deal 90% and 35%.

Flight Burst::desc.src: Arrow Storm recoil is increased and activates while grounded.

Uncertainty Principle::desc.src: Arrow and Grape Bombs gain +1 radius and phase through enemies. Bouncing Bomb has decreased velocity and gains +1 bounces, and Grape Bombs gain increased randomness and +2 projectiles.

Split Second::desc.src: Aura now travels faster with Invigorating Wave unlocked, but no longer gives mana.

Geocentrism::desc.src: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Alter Ego::desc.src: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.
Alter Ego::desc.dst: 覺醒 啟動門檻降低40% 但持續時間降低25%

Slow Boil::desc.src: Bakal's Grasp and Enraged Blow have their caps doubled, but Corruption charges 20% as fast.

Temblor::desc.src: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Hellfire::desc.src: Bash is replaced by a single hit, gaining +3 radius and dealing +85%, +10%, and +60%. Boiling Blood's cooldown is set to 2s, gains +40%, +50%, and burns twice as fast for 1s, but can't slow.

Ignition Whirlwind::desc.src: Blazing Powder adds +8 rotations to spin attack, but lowers the damage by 75%.

Gruesome Knots::desc.src: Bleeding and Twisted Tether deal double the damage, but Bleeding duration is reduced.

Coagulate::desc.src: Blood Connection and Eldritch Call's teleports launch you further and higher.

Lifestream::desc.src: Blood Sorrow has 4 times the damage and overhealth, but its duration is shortened by 75%.

Chaos Reach::desc.src: Blood Sorrow spends 20 less points of Blood Pool and inflicts enemies with 0.3 seconds of Bleeding per hit, but no longer grants overhealth.

Last Resort::desc.src: Bloodlust has doubled corrupted scaling and knockback, but deals -100% -60%.

Rusted Ichor::desc.src: Boiling Blood cooldown is reduced by 0.5s and inflicts 40% slowness, but deals no damage.

Fallout::desc.src: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

Net Shot::desc.src: Bryophyte Roots is now triggered from Buckshot, doubling its slowness and damage.

Dragon's Breath::desc.src: Buckshot will heal allies for 100% of your total Health Regen.

Burnt Shadows::desc.src: Buried Light burns faster and is controlled by the direction you face. Enemies in the light instead take 120%.

Meteor Crash::desc.src: Burning Sigil gains +6 radius and deals 4x the damage, but lasts half as long.

Madness::desc.src: Casts a random spell of your class every 3 seconds.

Superconductor::desc.src: Chain Lightning channels three massive lightning bolts through you, arcing to enemies within 8 blocks for 270% and stunning them for 1s. You take 10% more damage for 4s.

Accretion Chain::desc.src: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a {#}9999% explosion spell.
Accretion Chain::desc.dst: 連鎖閃電 變得更強且更慢，增加到 6 條鎖鏈，並聚集怪物，隨後造成 {#}9999% 爆炸傷害

Orbital Chain::desc.src: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 8000% explosion spell.

Backstep::desc.src: Charge and Teleport will travel backwards.
Backstep::desc.dst: 你的Charge and Teleport將會往後位移

Rally::desc.src: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Mob Mentality::desc.src: Commander places puppets ahead of where you are facing.

Dauntless Inferno::desc.src: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 150% each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

Death Sentence::desc.src: Courage will immediately combust Guardian Angels, dealing 4000% and enkindling Buckshot's arrows with 20% Main Attack damage.

Mana Surge::desc.src: Curse instead releases a calming wave with a radius of 8 blocks. Allies affected will have their Mana Regen and Mana Steal increased by 25% for 6s.

Pirouette::desc.src: Dancing Blade enhances Dash. Dashing into an enemy now vaults you upwards and resets dash as if you touched the ground.

Lightning Crash::desc.src: Dash becomes a downward dive. Ripple has doubled height amplification and deals 250% and 100%.

Flain Remnants::desc.src: Destroying a Puppet with Friendly Fire calls forth a Remnant. (Max 5) Each Remnant lasts for 20 seconds, fires an explosive tracking projectile every second that deals 95%, and increases your Main Attack damage by 15%.

Soul Eater::desc.src: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

Guardian::desc.src: Devout Union gains +20% damage redirection and +4 radius.

Heroine's Blessing::desc.src: Devout Union gains +25% damage redirection and +8 radius. Additionally, Mantles given by Enlightenment have +20% damage reduction.

Insoluble::desc.src: Dissolution now lasts 2.5 seconds, but grants only 35% resistance.

Fixate::desc.src: Distortion decays at a halved rate and Devitalize effects are doubled. However, Distortion effects on abilities are reduced by 40% and Meteor Shower now requires +50% Distortion per Meteor.

Elven Current::desc.src: Escape can be re-cast twice in mid-air.

Displace::desc.src: Etheric Slash deals massive knockback to enemies hit by Teleport.

Explosive Impact::desc.src: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

Fission::desc.src: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Sun Eater::desc.src: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Napalm::desc.src: Fire Creep increases Arrow Bomb damage by +15%, but deals 15 times the self-damage and lowers velocity. Scorched Earth radius is increased and deals +65%.

Tackle::desc.src: Flying Kick deals much more knockback and increases Collide damage by an additional 150%, 60%, and 10%.

Tidal Drift::desc.src: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Vedette::desc.src: Focus gets +10% damage per stack, but caps at 2. Crepuscular Ray can be cast at 2 Focus with decreased Focus drain, launching you into the air and immobilizing you.

Heat Shimmer::desc.src: Foul Play will no longer slay a Mirror Clone and will still provide its effects, but Mirror Clone count is reduced to 1. Tricks application is increased by 50%.

Scarce Comfort::desc.src: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

Escape Route::desc.src: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

Lit Fuse::desc.src: Friendly Fire now works on Totem as well. When Totem's timer runs out, it explodes, firing 5 beams in all directions, each dealing 500%.

Faustian Gambit::desc.src: Frog Dance triggers once with increased vertical velocity and knockback, and deals +400%.

Battlefield Brilliance::desc.src: Generalist instead makes your next Main Attack deal quadruple damage, followed by a tactical retreat.

Spectral Memory::desc.src: Ghostly Trigger lasts until landing, but no longer increases attack speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Brachiate::desc.src: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

Lasso::desc.src: Grappling Hook, War Scream, and Uproot now pull enemies with much more force.

Frenetic Spirit::desc.src: Guardian Angels damage is set to 10%, but shoot 40% faster and last 5 times longer. Frenzy's cap is increased by 55.

Lustrate::desc.src: Heal restores health at a slower rate, but Searing Light deals +150%.

Phoenix-Born::desc.src: Health Regeneration is increased by 0.75% for every 1% Health missing.

Starcrossed::desc.src: Hitting an enemy with Haunting Memory makes it Linked. You can have up to two targets Linked at once. When one Linked enemy takes damage, the other Linked enemy takes that damage as well. Haunted Memory's duration is increased by 5 seconds and its range is increased by 10 blocks.

Seeking Module::desc.src: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Lunge::desc.src: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Fissure::desc.src: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +275%, and +155%.

Divine Honor::desc.src: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals {#}-15% per hit.
Divine Honor::desc.dst: Radiance 的增幅增加 5%，但 Bash 每段傷害減少 {#}-15%

Methodical::desc.src: Initiator's reset time is reduced by 75%. Arrow Bomb area damage is halved, but direct hit damage is doubled.

Unstable Reaction::desc.src: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

Incision Elegy::desc.src: Lacerate becomes a forward-moving projectile, but no longer lunges.

Space Glide::desc.src: Lacerate performs a single horizontal jump and slash, dealing 500%.

Combo Stomp::desc.src: Landing directly on an enemy with Fierce Stomp sends you back into the air and resets Escape.

Wormhole::desc.src: Last Laugh instead casts Meteor. Malicious Mockery causes Meteor to apply 13 Trick stacks.

Culicidae Creed::desc.src: Leap becomes fully vertical, and Spectral Hover lasts twice as long.

Snowy Steps::desc.src: Leaves a trail of snow behind you.

Orbwalk::desc.src: Lightweaver Orbs gain +1 area of effect, 20%, and 20%, but move slower.

Find Thyself::desc.src: Masquerade now grants 75 Mana after switching between Masks 3 times.

Perfect Recall::desc.src: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

Cosmic Capture::desc.src: Meteor falls twice as fast, has +3 blast radius, and pulls enemies upon impact.

Gravity Well::desc.src: Meteor has increased blast radius and pulls enemies instead.

Lockdown::desc.src: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

Wavebreak::desc.src: Meteor's  damage is replaced by  damage. Psychokinesis can bounce up to 5 times, dealing 100% and 50% area damage, as well as 200% and 100% direct hit damage, increasing by 10% after each bounce. Mana Bank gains 3 less mana from Meteor.

Juggle::desc.src: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -10%.

Gentle Glow::desc.src: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

Pioneer's Echo::desc.src: Phantom Ray deals 7x damage, but only hits twice over 1 second. Decimator's increase and cap are raised to 140% and Quick Draw's activation threshold is decreased to 2.

River of Souls::desc.src: Phantom Ray gains massive radius, but reduced damage by 20%.

Reality Revision::desc.src: Phasing Beam instead makes Twain's Arc explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing its damage in a 5 block radius. Twain's Arc now has extreme recoil.

Greed::desc.src: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Living Museum::desc.src: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

Plague::desc.src: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Aubri's Tears::desc.src: Pool of Rejuvenation's range and duration are doubled, but Frog Dance deals no damage.
Aubri's Tears::desc.dst: Pool of Rejuvenation的範圍與傷害變成兩倍，但Frog Dance無法造成傷害

Self-sufficient::desc.src: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Three Bodies::desc.src: Pressure grants additional effects: Bash gains +4 radius, Uppercut gains +75%, and War Scream's buff gains +12s duration

Taunt::desc.src: Provoke's Cooldown is reduced to 8s but its duration is reduced to 3s.

Magnet::desc.src: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

Perilous Flare::desc.src: Pyrokinesis moves much slower, but has an increased Area of Effect and  +50%.

Troll Barge::desc.src: Quake allows you to charge forth, dealing 80% and 20% to any mobs hit, and ending with a powerful stomp for 400% and 150%. This will leave you vulnerable.

Earthen Splinter::desc.src: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for 1200%.

Oneself Unto All::desc.src: Radiance's radius extends 4 blocks beyond Bash and buffs allies with your stats instead of theirs.

Punishment::desc.src: Reflected damage blinds enemies for 1s and makes them 10% more vulnerable to attacks for 3s.

Blazing Effigy::desc.src: Regeneration increases Totem's damage by +14% +6% instead of restoring health.

Windsurf::desc.src: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

Reckless Abandon::desc.src: Sacrifice War Scream's defense bonus to give Tempest +5%, +15%, 5% and 3 extra hits.

Cannulate::desc.src: Sacrificial Shrine costs -5 Blood Pool to cast and health drain is halved.

Efflorescence::desc.src: Serpent's Garden now centers to where you land with Swan Dive. Damage of Swan Dive, Serpent's Garden and Jasmine Bloom are distributed across all elements.

Bound by Blood::desc.src: Shadow Projection's teleport range, duration, and launch strength is doubled.

Torment Liturgy::desc.src: Shadow Siphon now immediately refreshes Vanish when triggered, but reduces Surprise Strike's multiplier by -30%.

Paragon::desc.src: Shield Strike deals 600% damage. Mantle of the Bovemist's cooldown is reduced by 15s, but is limited to one shield charge.

Ergosphere::desc.src: Storm Dance instead lets your Totems pull enemies within their radius. Totem duration is decreased.

Power Fist::desc.src: Striking enemies with an empty hand greatly knocks them back.

Requiem::desc.src: Sunflare regenerates twice the health and mana.

Twisting Threads::desc.src: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal 65%. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

Inversion::desc.src: Teleport will grant you 3 seconds of levitation.

Intangible::desc.src: The knockback you take is drastically reduced, and reflected damage deals large knockback.

Solar Wind::desc.src: Thunderstorm disables Meteor, grants +3 thunderbolts, +3 radius and deals 100% and 110% each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 400% bonus damage.

Furious Effigy::desc.src: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Dead Weight::desc.src: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Sublimation::desc.src: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

Totemic Fuse::desc.src: Totemic Smash deals +150%, +150%, +150%, and +120% but totemic smash loses 30% radius.

Flurry of Blows::desc.src: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

Cherry Bombs::desc.src: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal 100%, 30%, 30%, and 30% instantly.

Vitriol::desc.src: Uncontainable Corruption decreases Corrupted duration by 75% and gives drastically more damage, but disables Enraged Blow. Massacre adds 5 times as much corruption.

Roving Assassin::desc.src: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.

Hurricane's Eye::desc.src: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Desperate Measures::desc.src: Walk Speed increases by 1% and Jump Height increases by 2% for every 1% hp missing.

Clamber::desc.src: Wall Jump becomes a sheer vertical climb.

Final Gambit::desc.src: When Second Chance activates, all allies within 10 blocks of you get a 20% damage boost for 15s.

Expunge::desc.src: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals 15% of your max health.

Outbreak::desc.src: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

Freerunner::desc.src: When your sprint bar is under 30% full, increase your sprint speed by +150%.

Grand Influence::desc.src: While above 80% maximum health, allies within 12 blocks gain 15% increased health gain from all sources and 25% Walk Speed.

Saviour's Sacrifice::desc.src: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Manic Edge::desc.src: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

Old Spark::desc.src: Whirlwind transforms into a travelling projectile, exploding on contact and knocking enemies into the air. Crouch to rise with them.

Disassociate::desc.src: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal 30% less damage.

Regicide::desc.src: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

Lightweight::desc.src: You no longer take fall damage.

Divine Right::desc.src: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 3%.
Divine Right::desc.dst: 你的最大生命上限削減 75% ，每被削檢 100 點生命值，Sacred Surge'的傷害增加 3%

Peaceful Effigy::desc.src: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Forest's Blessing::desc.src: Your hound gains 50% more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by -30%.

Oneiro::desc.src: Your maximum Mana Bank is increased by 50, but your spells now charge it by -3 less per hit.

Strings of Fate::desc.src: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.
